sufficient_route.assumption: For root F0 of encoding length N0, every reachable persisted nonterminal Ft has a certified variable-decreasing successor with DeltaC <= A(N0)*DeltaV, where A(N0)<=N0^k for one fixed k.
sufficient_route.consequence: C(Ft) <= C0 + A(N0)*V0 <= N0 + N0^(k+1), hence persisted clause count is polynomial in N0.

circular_route_countersequence.check: DeltaV=1; DeltaC=C_t; therefore a_req,t=C_t satisfies the local degree-one current-state polynomial bound.
circular_route_countersequence.global_growth: C_t=2^t*C0; for t=Theta(N0) this is exponential in root size.
circular_route_countersequence.conclusion: A polynomial bound in current C alone does not close the global polynomial envelope.

allowed_universal_targets: a_star(Ft) <= A(|F0|) for one fixed polynomial A and every reachable persisted state
a_star(Ft) <= poly(S(Ft)) together with an independent proof S(Ft)<=poly(|F0|)
a stronger nonlinear root-controlled potential with polynomial representation and strict certified descent

relation_to_R48I.warning: Even normalized Theta(r^2) pressure in a root whose encoding grows polynomially with r would refute constant weights but not root-polynomial pressure.
